tests.description: Reference: WRF 4.8 em_quarter_ss idealized supercell (GNU real32 build, dx = 2 km, dt = 12 s, 40 layers, WSM6 only), step 250 row 23 dumped by the instrumented ctessum-claude/WRF fork (module_esm_dump with esm_dump_inner hooks inside mp_wsm6_run of the ctessum-claude/MMM-physics fork, commit 52cfbd7) and replayed through the real64 (kind_phys = real64) standalone kernels/wsm6_driver. INPUTS are the kernel's input state (t, qi, qr, qs, qg, den, delz of tile column 24), i.e. the state the fallout block sees at the start of the sub-step. REFERENCE FLUXES are Fortran-derived: the kernel's fall arrays (fall(:,k,:) = post-fallout density x fall speed / delz for k >= 2, and the semi-Lagrangian surface precipitation / delz / dtcld at k = 1), multiplied by delz, from three real64 replays at ESM_DT = 0.04, 0.02, 0.01 s and Richardson-extrapolated to dt -> 0 (second order; the kernel's fluxes converge linearly in dt to the donor-cell fluxes rho v_t q, so the extrapolation removes the residual to ~1e-12 relative). REFERENCE TENDENCIES are the FORMULA, not the Fortran: (F[k+1] - F[k])/(rho[k] dz[k]) with F[NLEV+1] = 0, evaluated by the filler on the extrapolated fluxes; WSM6's own fallout increment is a forward semi-Lagrangian PLM step (nislfv_rain_plm/plm6) that is not rate x dt: at the WRF step (dt = 12 s) the PLM increment/dt differs from this donor-cell divergence layer by layer by factors 0.41-1.51 for rain (Linf relative difference 59% over the layers carrying more than 0.1 % of the peak divergence), and the PLM surface precipitation rate is 1.418e-06 vs the donor-cell 1.415e-06 kg m^-2 s^-1; as dt -> 0 both converge to the values asserted here. Cloud-ice fluxes have no kernel counterpart above the surface (fallc is dumped only at k = 1), so F_i and dqi_dt are checked against the same formulae evaluated by the filler on the input state (N_i = min(max(5.38e7 (rho q_i)^0.75, 1e3), 1e6), D = min(dicon sqrt(rho q_i/N_i), dimax), v_i = 1.49e4 D^1.31) -- a wiring check, not an independent reference. Real64 replay fluxes agree with the real32 in-model fall arrays to ~2e-6 relative (the dumped pvtr/pvts/pvtg are real32). Residual esm-vs-extrapolated mismatch (real32 constants and default-real literals of the kernel, FORTRAN_BUGS.md N2; measured with zero tolerances): fluxes and tendencies <= 1.1e-7 of each column's maximum (rain 8.8e-8, snow 1.1e-7, graupel 1.1e-7, ice 1.0e-7), surface rates 1.1-1.3e-7 relative -- the same floor as the rate models (the kernel's real32 pvtr/pvts/pvtg, bvtr = 0.800000011920929, den0, 1.49e4, 1.31 and 5.38e7 versus the exact esm constants); column tolerances are 1e-6 of each reference column's maximum (Linf_error), scalar tolerances rel 2e-6, i.e. 5-10x above. Tolerances are set 5-10x above. Regime: mature storm column (i = 24): rain up to 1.4e-2, snow 3e-3, graupel 1e-2, ice 3e-4 kg/kg; all four categories fall, rain and graupel reach the surface.
